title: The Hollow Horizon
author: Petra Eriksen
blurb: Paloma Kavanagh, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
